spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: Function definition — Supports required-params, defaultable-params, included-record-param and rest-param in the signature
reason: The asserted behavior requires the executable entry-point protocol to parse command-line argument "-10" as the int parameter i and print -10. unsupported_constructs: Command-line parsing and binding @args ["-10"] to main(int i), including recognition of a negative integer argument
test_design_notes: @output -10 asserts the result of command-line parsing; io:println is instrumentation and is not itself the unsupported feature.
